token_metric: Current ByteTokenizer baseline: one token per UTF-8 byte; this is not a claim about future BPE/Unigram token counts.
truth_boundary: The audited S0 Ukrainian sample is project-authored fixture data, not an external Ukrainian corpus.
Zero drift on this clean sample does not imply zero drift on external corpora.
Regression fixtures intentionally exercise dirty Unicode/HTML/whitespace cases separately.
Natural text uses NFC, never NFKC; common apostrophe, quote, dash, ґ/г, і/ї/й distinctions are preserved.
Code receives newline canonicalization only and bypasses natural-text whitespace, HTML, NFC, NBSP, and soft-hyphen cleanup.
